description: Turns of an upper arm against its shoulder-girdle link, as rotation vectors (radians) in the skin's rest frame (x forward, y to the subject's left, z up), about the shoulder joint. Rounded from a fitted driver swing: the trail arm at the top of the backswing (77 degrees in all, 65 about the arm) and the lead arm at the finish (85 degrees, 83 about the arm).
